fields.statement: Change set 01M7PZQ4 (throwaway projections leak): the /tmp leak's cause is found (workspace.projection() falls back to a bare Ctx with no Getenv, so the throwaway index goes to the real /tmp untracked by the test guard, and the test helper ctxWorkspace never closes it; reproduced on current code: 29 folders from 4 tests). The intent also says 'look at why rhiza ship open-pr needs 2.2 GB RSS'. What I found: open-pr's pre-push check runs rhiza check in-process over a fresh checkout (ship_prepush.go prePushRhizaCheck); rhiza check alone on this repo (7,298 log entries) peaks at 832 MB RSS. Cutting that needs profiling of the check/fold path, unrelated to the leak's files. Where should the open-pr memory work go?
